neural_colab.spec_reference: spec-v1 section 5: separate Colab authorization/setup step required; local CPU bake-off proceeds independently

mono_sqam_smoke_reference.note: Published mono SQAM outputs (7 holdout recordings, 15 dB input SDR) are smoke reference only and do not substitute for stereo evaluation.

dev_decision.summary: Select aspade_mit + detect_hard_clip_v2 as the E4 stereo/album safety and CPU freeze candidate. It outperforms current_snapshot_auto on BOTH dev corpora with strictly positive 95% paired cluster CIs, 100% defect case coverage, 0/9 negative-control FPs, 0 polarity violations, and 3x-41x faster CPU execution, whereas reg_ar_mit only wins on 5-sinusoid dev-v1 signals and loses by -1.40 dB to current_sparse on polyphonic stereo mixes (dev-e3-v1).
dev_decision.caveat: Dev selection only. Neither DR, peak reduction, nor dev SDR proves perceptual preference or release readiness. Promotion requires E4 stereo/album safety + CPU freeze and E5 sealed holdout + blind listening panel.

dev-v1.metric_policy: gain-controlled masked SDR (single stereo whole-track scalar gain, delay=0, eps=1e-20) + uncompensated masked SDR + whole-track stereo SI-SDRi

dev_decision.reason: reg_ar_mit__v2_windowed passes zero negative-control FP, zero polarity violations, zero failures, and achieves positive 95% paired cluster CI over current_snapshot_auto on dev without touching sealed.
dev_decision.caveat: Dev selection only — NOT a release claim or perceptual preference claim. Requires E4 stereo/album safety + CPU freeze and E5 sealed + blind panel.
